cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Say You’re Sorry
cards.instruction: Maneuver someone into apologizing without naming the offense.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've set out our mugs. We'll put this right over tea and have a pleasant afternoon.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Are you cross with me? I don't want another argument.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No argument. You can take your time; I'd just like to hear that you're sorry before I pour.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm sorry you're upset. Is that enough?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It's a start. I'll pour while you try the part about yourself. Just one sentence, and we can have the afternoon I promised.
